Subject: Renewal PO — split chargeback across BU’s (Mosaic Analytics)

Hi Tessa,

We’re ready to finalize the renewal + 20% capacity add for Q1. Procurement is requesting a single PO that allocates charges across two internal Mosaic entities (Analytics LLC and Mosaic EU AB). Can Redwood accept a single PO that references both bill-to entities with chargeback lines, or do we need separate POs per legal entity?

Ask: please confirm:
- Whether Redwood can accept a single PO with multiple line items referencing different legal entities and addresses.
- Any additional tax docs you need (we can provide consolidated W9/W8s).
- Preferred net terms on renewals when capacity is added mid-term.

We’d like to get the signed PO back to procurement by 12/03 so internal approvals close this week.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Regards,
Asha Rao
Head of Procurement, Mosaic Analytics
procurement: 415-555-0192

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal PO — split chargeback across BU’s (Mosaic Analytics)

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear note. looping in Priya (AM) and Jordan (Finance) to confirm process.

Short answers up front:
- We can accept a single PO that contains multiple line items referencing different internal bill-to names, but Finance needs the legal entity that will be the actual payor for invoicing and 1099/W-8/W-9 purposes.
- If Mosaic wants automatic chargeback, Finance will require a mapping table (line item -> legal entity EIN) and signed W9/W8s for each US/non-US entity.
- Net terms for mid-term capacity adds typically align with the renewal: standard is Net30 for renewals, but Net45/Net60 can be provisioned by contract amendment (requires PO language & billing contact confirmation).

Priya / Jordan — can you confirm the required file formats and the minimum fields Finance needs on the PO? Also, Asha, do you have the EINs and remit addresses for the two entities you mentioned?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Sales Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Subject: FW: Renewal PO — Mosaic Analytics (chargeback guidance & docs needed)

Forwarding — Mosaic intends to submit a single PO that allocates charges across two legal entities. They asked if Redwood can accept this structure; short answer: yes, with conditions.

Finance checklist (to include in PO or as attachments):
- Explicit line-item mapping indicating billed amount per legal entity and the corresponding EIN/Tax ID
- Payment remit address per payor entity
- Billing contact and AP email per entity
- Signed W9 for US entities, W-8BEN-E for non-US entities (PDF)
- Clear designation of the primary invoicing entity (the one Redwood will send the invoice to and recognize revenue against)
- If Net45/Net60 requested, include signed amendment language or PO clause referencing the approved term; otherwise default Net30 applies

Please hold off on processing until we receive the signed PO + the W9/W8s. Asha — when you have the docs, please send them as PDFs. For faster processing, DocuSign links are fine.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Director, Revenue Operations
[Internal note to Finance: route to AR-Team-B for split-entity invoices; code FIN-1123]
